_doc: Use this payload for content generation bounties: blog writing, SEO meta descriptions, translations, and market analysis reports. Supports both Chinese and English locales via bounty_metadata.locale.
title: 美股指數期權策略分析報告撰寫
title_en: US Stock Index Options Strategy Analysis Report
description: 撰寫一份基於當前市場情緒和技術指標的SPX/QQQ期權策略分析報告。需包含：支撐/阻力位分析、隱含波動率IV變化、建議的期權策略（鐵鷹、垂直價差等）。參考Gamma、Delta和Theta指標。
description_en: Write an SPX/QQQ options strategy analysis report based on current market sentiment and technical indicators. Include: support/resistance levels, IV changes, recommended strategies (iron condor, vertical spreads). Reference Gamma, Delta, and Theta.
_micro_reward_note: 0.5 Credits — suitable for medium-difficulty content generation tasks.
evaluation_spec: 報告需至少800字；包含3個以上技術指標分析；至少推薦2種期權策略；引用當前市場數據；中英文皆可接受。
_evaluation_spec_note: For text bounties, evaluation_spec is displayed to solvers as the acceptance criteria.
